title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.24 - two co-op attribution fixes. Debilitate is now credited to the player who played it. Doubling Vulnerable's effect reaches damage from inside Vulnerable itself and never showed up as an effect of its own, so the whole multiplier went to whoever applied Vulnerable and the card that doubled it counted for nothing. Its credit is measured against the rest of the stack, so it is worth more when the attacker's own Paper Phrog and Cruelty have already raised the bonus it doubles - both of those were already correct and still stay with the attacker. Second, a summoned pet's mitigation now goes to whoever paid for its hit points, split in proportion when several players chipped in. Legion of Bone, and a Bone Brew thrown at an ally, put HP in front of a teammate, and every point the pet then soaked was being credited to that teammate rather than to the Necrobinder who bought it. Still works on game v0.107.1 and later.
